name: SN 2006ex field (Hubble)
blurb: SN 2006ex field, the host galaxy of a Type Ia supernova, seen by Hubble.
label: sn12930-hubble
story: Here a star exploded as the Type Ia supernova SN 2006ex, found by the Sloan Digital Sky Survey. Hubble returned to its host galaxy to read the colors at the site of the explosion and judge how much star formation was going on there.
